searchText: The length would be part of whatever higher level transport system you are using. For example, devp2p uses an RLP-like mechanism for its transport, which means each transaction is already length prefixed. Also, what you are proposing isn't SSZ (not sure if that was intentional or not). What is not SSZ in this? ``` 0x01 || yParity || r || s || chainid || nonce || gasPrice || gasLimit || to || value || data ``` <@!425279588009246720> The last item here is variable length, which means it needs to have an offset, and that offset is from the beginning of the SSZ payload.
